summary: Collects best current practice examples of SIP call flows showing interworking with the public telephone network (PSTN). Scenarios include SIP to PSTN, PSTN to SIP, and PSTN to PSTN via SIP, with PSTN signaling illustrated using ISDN and ISUP. Elements include user agents, proxies and gateways.

eli5.summary: This shows how an Internet phone call turns into a regular phone call and back. It follows each message step by step through the gateways that translate between the two worlds.
